title: Feature Request: Automatically clone selected panels when connecting a new display
line: Panels can now be set to add a copy of themselves to newly connected screens that have no panels.
explanation: Plasma could only clone a panel by hand with the Clone Panel button, so people who connect new screens often had to recreate their panel on each one. plasmashell now remembers a per-panel "cloneToNewScreens" setting; when a screen is connected at runtime and no panel belongs to it yet (including panels waiting for that screen), every panel with the setting is cloned to it at the same edge, once the new desktop is ready. Copies never inherit the setting, so they don't multiply. Panel Settings gets a "New screens: Add a copy of this panel" checkbox with a help button explaining that copies aren't kept in sync.

commits.message:
shell: optionally add a copy of a panel to newly connected screens

Setting up the same panel on every screen meant cloning it by hand each
time a new screen was connected. Panels now have an option to copy
themselves to any newly connected screen that doesn't have panels yet.

BUG: 497100

panel config: add an option to copy the panel to new screens

Setting up the same panel on every screen meant cloning it by hand each
time a new screen was connected. The panel settings now have a checkbox
to add a copy of the panel to newly connected screens without panels.

BUG: 497100

media.caption: Master: a second screen is connected and stays without a panel
With the option on, the new screen gets a copy of the panel with all its widgets
Master Panel Settings: only a manual Clone Panel button
New "New screens: Add a copy of this panel" option with its help text
